correctness.rationale: The explicit orientation parametrization partitions cases by constant versus mixed hub-spoke direction. Mixed runs have forced unflippable boundary edges and every within-run rim edge is individually reversible; source/sink counts of oriented paths have P_l(z)=sum_s C(l,2s-1)z^s and B(x,z)=zx/(1-2x+(1-z)x^2). Cyclic run compositions contribute (2m/k)z^(m-k)[x^m]B^k, and uniform spokes require the one-wrong-way-edge correction. Extracting the coefficient at z^m yields the Lucas identity via logarithms. Independently enumerated every directed-edge orientation and legal flip for m=3..6, matching all four claimed histograms. The unrestricted result relies on the run proof, not the finite check.
